title.value: On learning Whittle index policy for restless bandits with scalable regret
title.justification: The title of the paper is directly extracted from the provided text at the start of the document.
title.quote: On learning Whittle index policy for restless bandits with scalable regret

extractions.description: The paper presents a reinforcement learning algorithm called RB-TSDE, designed for resource allocation and scheduling problems modeled as restless bandits (RBs). It addresses the challenge of scalable regret in reinforcement learning algorithms by considering a model-based approach tuned to the structure of the underlying RB model. The paper provides regret bounds for the proposed algorithm, showing that it scales better compared to standard RL algorithms in these settings. It includes theoretical analysis and numerical experiments to support the claims.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper's main focus is on developing a reinforcement learning algorithm for resource allocation and scheduling in networked systems using restless bandits models, which is a mathematical and computational optimization focus rather than a direct concern with Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Reinforcement learning is an attractive approach to learn good resource allocation and scheduling policies
